name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda - SUPPLEMENTAL PACKET POSTED
agenda_text:
SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 24, 2026 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84070910557
  Webinar ID: 840 7091 0557
  One-tap Mobile:
  +16469313860,,84070910557# OR +13017158592,,84070910557#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 646 931 3860 OR +1 301 715 8592
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Honig, Davis, Pearl, Mayor Pro Tem Halpern,
  Mayor McSweeney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of May 27, 2026 City Council Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report

4.  Chamber of Commerce (Verbal Report)
 CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  SECOND READING AND ADOPTION BY REFERENCE OF THE 2025 LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY BUILDING, ELECTRICAL, PLUMBING, MECHANICAL,
  RESIDENTIAL, GREEN BUILDING STANDARDS, AND EXISTING BUILDING
  CODES; TOGETHER WITH CERTAIN AMENDMENTS, DELETIONS, AND
  ADDITIONS; AND INCLUDING FINDINGS, FEES, AND PENALTIES;
  ORDINANCE NO. 314-26 - Waive second reading in full and adopt Ordinance No.
  314-26 and find that the ordinance is exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act.

  ORDINANCE NO. 314-26: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE,
  CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING BY REFERENCE TITLE 26 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  CODE, INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2025 CALIFORNIA BUILDING CODE;
  TITLE 27 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND
  AMENDING THE 2025 CALIFORNIA ELECTRICAL CODE; TITLE 28 OF THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2025
  CALIFORNIA PLUMBING CODE; TITLE 29 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE,
  INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2025 CALIFORNIA MECHANICAL CODE;
  TITLE 30 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND
  AMENDING THE 2025 CALIFORNIA RESIDENTIAL CODE; TITLE 31 OF THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2025
  CALIFORNIA GREEN BUILDING STANDARDS CODE; AND TITLE 33 OF THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2025
  CALIFORNIA EXISTING BUILDING CODE; TOGETHER WITH CERTAIN
  AMENDMENTS, DELETIONS AND ADDITIONS, INCLUDING FINDINGS, FEES AND
  PENALTIES; AND AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE
  (CHAPTER 8.1-BUILDING CODE; CHAPTER 8.2-ELECTRICAL CODE; CHAPTER 8.3-
  PLUMBING CODE; CHAPTER 8.4-MECHANCIAL CODE; CHAPTER 8.7-RESIDENTIAL
  CODE; CHAPTER 8.8-GREEN BUILDING STANDARDS CODE AND CHAPTER 8.10-
  EXISTING BUILDING CODE) AND APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION

2.  SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE TO ESTABLISH
  PUBLIC RIGHT OF WAY ENCROACHMENT REGULATIONS; ORDINANCE
  NO. 315-26; AND RESOLUTION TO UPDATE ENCROACHMENT PERMIT
  FEES; RESOLUTION NO. 2462-26 - Waive second reading in full and adopt
  Ordinance No. 315-26 to amend the Municipal Code to establish public right-of-
  way encroachment regulations, find that the ordinance is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act and adopt Resolution No. 2462-26 to update
  encroachment permit fees.

  ORDINANCE NO. 315-26: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE TO UPDATE PUBLIC
  RIGHT-OF-WAY ENCROACHMENT REGULATIONS CHAPTER 7.5 PUBLIC RIGHT-
  OF-WAY ENCROACHMENTS AND APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION
   RESOLUTION NO. 2462-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE CITY
  COUNCIL ESTABLISHING FEES FOR ENCROACHMENT PERMIT PROCESSING
  SERVICES

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective June 15, 2026 in the amount of
  $1,430,289.08 (Warrant Register is on file with the City Clerk)

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  DESIGNATION OF NEW DEPUTY CITY ENGINEER; RESOLUTION NO.
  2463-26 - Adopt Resolution 2463-26 appointing Mark Wilde as the new
  Deputy City Engineer.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2463-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPOINTING MARK WILDE AS THE NEW
  DEPUTY CITY ENGINEER

  2.  APPROVING A COOPERATION AGREEMENT WITH THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY FOR THE LOS
  ANGELES URBAN COUNTY COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK
  GRANT PROGRAM FOR FISCAL YEARS 2027-2029; RESOLUTION NO.
  2464-26 - Adopt Resolution No. 2464-26.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2464-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING PARTICIPATION IN THE LOS
  ANGELES URBAN COUNTY PROGRAM

  3.  ACCEPTANCE OF TRAFFIC SIGNAL CONTROLLER REPLACEMENT
  PROJECT PHASE 1; FILE NOTICE OF COMPLETION - Accept the Traffic
  Signal Controller Replacement Project Phase 1; authorize the City Clerk to
  execute and record a “Notice of Completion” for the project on behalf of the
  City; and approve a budget amendment in the amount of $4,336 from the
  unallocated General Fund balance to the project expenditure account to
  cover the final project costs.
   4.  ACCEPTANCE OF THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE CIVIC CENTER
  COURTYARD IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT; FILING OF NOTICE OF
  COMPLETION AND APPROVAL OF KIESEL LANDSCAPE
  ARCHITECTURE CONTRACT AMENDMENT NO. 4 - Accept the Civic
  Center Courtyard Improvements Project, authorize the City Clerk to execute
  and record a “Notice of Completion” for the project on behalf of the City,
  approve Amendment No. 4 to the Professional Services Agreement with
  Kiesel Landscape Architecture, Inc. and authorize the Mayor to execute the
  amendment on behalf of the City.

OLD BUSINESS: None

NEW BUSINESS: None

CLOSED SESSION:

1.  Conference with Legal Counsel – Anticipated Litigation
  Significant Exposure to Litigation (California Government Code Section
  54956.9(d)(2)): 1 potential case.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, June 18, 2026 at 10:40 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  June 18, 2026
